title: Toad River Lodge RV Park

services.name: Alaska Highway Cabin Rentals
services.desc: Escape to the natural beauty of northern British Columbia with Toad River Lodge cabin rentals. Our cozy and comfortable cabins are the perfect home base for your next outdoor adventure. We have complete services for the Alaska Highway

services.name: RV Campground
services.desc: Our RV Campground is the perfect British Columbia destination for big rigs as well as slide-in truck campers and everything in between. The RV park is open all year round with full services available from early May to mid-October (weather permitting) for $47.50 per night + sales tax. We would love to have you stop in! blurb: There are many stories of how different places got their names along the highway. We kind of liked this one about toad so we’ve adopted it. Back around 1942 when the Canadian and U.S. armies were busy building the Alaska highway (it was not the super highway you just drove in on), there were problems crossing the river because a bridge was not yet built, so it was par for the course to be “towed across”.
